name: Ice Hockey Puck
summary: Near-black satin vulcanized rubber puck with softened edges and a diamond crosshatch grip band.
description: Near-black satin vulcanized rubber puck with softened edges and a diamond crosshatch grip band.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Editable 128-sided cylinder with live 0.65 mm three-segment edge bevel. Near-black satin faces and a rubber edge band using an original 1024×512 normal map analytically baked from two crossed diagonal wave height gradients. PNG retained in sources; GLB embeds JPEG. Both materials use linear base colour (0.0025, 0.0030, 0.0035), metallic 0, roughness 0.72 and reduced specular IOR level 0.08 to approximate a porous carbon-filled rubber surface with broad, weak reflections. Studio lights are unchanged. Lying flat on its lower face. This asset is a puck, not a ball.

display.origin: Floor contact point under the object centre; puck lies flat.

accuracy_notes: The diamond band is normal detail only; side silhouette stays cylindrical. The sampled crosshatch is a simplified moulded grip pattern, not a manufacturer drawing. No logos, mass, friction, freezing behaviour or physics are simulated. Reduced specular response approximates a porous carbon-filled surface; material values are visual estimates, not laboratory measurements.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry, materials and analytical texture bakes; no external models, fonts, images or logos.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
